worldcombat.skill.thunder.summary: Gather the clouds, then drop a column of thunder onto the target point from the sky: a small but brutal hit. It always lands in rain, scatters more in sun, and a roof blocks it entirely.
worldcombat.skill.thunder.description.0: The bolt deals about %1$s special Electric damage where it lands.
worldcombat.skill.thunder.description.1: Every enemy within %1$s blocks of the strike is hit, and each that actually takes damage has a %2$s%% chance to be left paralysed: paralysis lasts about 40 s, halving movement speed and giving a 25%% chance for each attempted action to fail (Electric types are immune); it can also be cleansed.
worldcombat.skill.thunder.description.2: It strikes up to %1$s blocks away after a %2$s s charge; you may pick open ground to lead the landing, so stepping away dodges it. It always lands in rain, falls to half accuracy on a clear day with open sky and to about 70%% otherwise. If the chosen spot has a roof or rock overhead, the bolt is blocked entirely and deals nothing.
worldcombat.skill.thunder.use.0: Drop a bolt on a target from afar
worldcombat.skill.thunder.use.1: Call a sure strike in the rain
worldcombat.skill.thunder.use.2: Shut the bolt down with a roof
worldcombat.skill.thunder.preference.cha: On: charges 6 ticks longer for more power and a wider column (a larger area), at the cost of a longer recovery and cooldown. Off: the bolt falls sooner but hits slightly softer over a smaller area.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of calling the bolt. Larger values strike first from further away.
On: favour wet targets, which are easier to numb, at the risk of ignoring a dry real threat. Off: only the threat itself counts.
worldcombat.skill.thunder.timing: After it lands, recovery is %1$s s and cooldown %3$s s, costing %2$s PP.
